verdict.rationale: MoonPay's docs say it supports 100+ cryptocurrencies and reference a list-assets endpoint that returns CAIP-19 identifiers, which encode both chain and token. The enterprise pages mention automatic conversion of incoming fiat into stablecoins. None of the evidence names USDC, USDT or any specific network, so a developer cannot match customer holdings from what is shown here. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented list naming USDC/USDT and peer stablecoins, the named networks each is supported on, and independent or hands-on confirmation of that coverage.
